5.caption: Jeff is having a bad day, and is determined to make it everybody else's problem.

10.caption: Jeff is being a bit of a diva and could really use some chill-out time.

15.caption: Jeff snuck outside and immediately began stressing the hell out.

20.caption: Jeff was scolded for scratching the arm of the couch. Naughty kitty...

25.caption: Jeff is freaked out by the vacuum. We may need to earn back his trust... with treats.

30.caption: Jeff is unimpressed with the bow on his head. Sorry, Jeff.

35.caption: Jeff is a bit stressed out by unusual, loud noises that the neighbors are making.

40.caption: Jeff is trying to convince us that he's starving. His food bowl is still half full.

45.caption: Jeff is hidden under the bed. He may be frightened, or he may just need peace and quiet.

50.caption: Jeff can't find any birds or critters to watch outside through the window today.

52.caption: Jeff is spending some time in gremlin mode.

54.caption: Jeff is having some difficulty finding a good spot to nap.

56.caption: Jeff was awoken from his nap. He's sulking a bit.

58.caption: Jeff lost a toy under the couch. It didn't take long for him to pick out a new toy.

60.caption: Jeff is watching a bug on the ceiling. He knows that it's out of reach.

62.caption: Jeff woke up, ate, played, and went back to sleep.

64.caption: Jeff is trying to loaf. He still needs a little bit of practice.

66.caption: Jeff is begging for extra treats today. It won't work, but we admire the enthusiasm.

68.caption: Jeff is performing a cat scan.

70.caption: Jeff wound himself up too much while playing today. He's overstimulated now.

72.caption: Jeff is trying to be a good listener, but is struggling to stay awake...

74.caption: Jeff is staring directly into the sun. Don't worry, he seems to like it.

76.caption: Jeff is getting booped. His feelings on this are neutral.

78.caption: Jeff is happily sleeping in the middle of the living room floor.

80.caption: Jeff is presenting his belly. Don't fall for the trap...

82.caption: Jeff is playing with his toys today. We doubt he'll clean up after himself.

84.caption: Jeff is occupying the rocking chair. Oh, were you about to sit there?

86.caption: Jeff had a wonderful big stretch, then fell asleep in a ray of sun.

88.caption: Jeff is cuddling with his blanket after hours of biscuit-making.

90.caption: Jeff stole a piece of "Human Food" and devoured it out of sight.

92.caption: Jeff is working on solving the housing crisis. It's a noble effort for a cat.

94.caption: Jeff got a lot of attention today. He enjoyed being the center of attention.

96.caption: Jeff is being very affectionate and wants pets... despite our need for privacy.

98.caption: Jeff was called "The cutest big boy ever" and that meant a lot to him.

100.caption: Jefferson is having the BEST DAY EVER, full of treats, play, sunshine and naps.
